lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Have, There Is, Need and Want
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say what you have, need and want, and ask what there is for lunch today.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask a server if there is a set lunch today, say what you want, and ask for a spoon.
lessons.title: What Is Available for Lunch
lessons.objective: Ask what the restaurant has today, say what you want or need, and request a utensil.
lessons.focus: Use il y a for availability, avoir for what someone has, je voudrais for a polite wish, and il faut for what must be done.
lessons.scene: At a neighborhood lunch counter, Sam checks the midday set meal and asks for a spoon.

cards.fr: Vous avez une table pour deux ?
cards.en: Do you have a table for two?

cards.fr: Il y a une formule du midi ?
J'ai besoin d'une cuillère, s'il vous plaît.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Bonjour. Vous avez une table pour deux ?
reader.en: Hello. Do you have a table for two?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, près de la fenêtre.
reader.en: Yes, near the window.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Il y a une formule du midi ?
reader.en: Is there a set lunch?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, il y a une soupe, un plat et un dessert.
reader.en: Yes, there is soup, a main dish, and a dessert.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: J'ai très faim. Je voudrais la soupe.
reader.en: I'm very hungry. I would like the soup.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Voici la soupe et la sauce.
reader.en: Here are the soup and the sauce.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: J'ai besoin d'une cuillère et d'une serviette, s'il vous plaît.
reader.en: I need a spoon and a napkin, please.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Il faut payer à la caisse après le repas.
reader.en: Of course. You have to pay at the register after the meal.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Talk about where you are going to eat, what you plan to order, and what you can do.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell a travel companion where you are going to eat, then ask the server if you can pay by card.
lessons.title: Going to Lunch and Asking Permission
lessons.objective: Say where you are going to eat, what you plan to order, and whether you can pay by card.
lessons.focus: Use aller à for destinations, aller + infinitive for a plan, faire for what a place makes, and pouvoir for permission.
lessons.scene: Sam and a friend plan to eat at a bistro near the market, then ask the server about takeaway and card payment.

cards.fr: Je vais au marché pour manger.
cards.en: I am going to the market to eat.
We are going to order sandwiches.
We are going to have lunch at the bistro.

cards.fr: Vous faites des sandwichs à emporter ?
cards.en: Do you make sandwiches to go?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Nous allons déjeuner au bistrot près du marché.
reader.en: We are going to have lunch at the bistro near the market.

reader.speaker: Friend
reader.fr: Il y a une sandwicherie au coin ?
reader.en: Is there a sandwich shop on the corner?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Oui. Je vais au marché pour manger.
reader.en: Yes. I am going to the market to eat.

reader.speaker: Friend
reader.fr: Et moi, je vais commander un sandwich.

reader.fr: Bonjour. Vous faites des sandwichs à emporter ?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, et vous pouvez aussi manger ici.
reader.en: Yes, and you can also eat here.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Je peux m’asseoir ici ? Je peux payer par carte ?
reader.en: Can I sit here? Can I pay by card?

reader.speaker: Server

reader.en: Yes, of course.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say what you and others eat, share and pay, using regular present-tense verbs.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell a lunch companion what you eat, ask if they eat avocado, and say how you are paying.
lessons.title: What We Eat, Share and Pay
lessons.objective: Describe what you and others eat, share, prepare and pay for in the French present tense.
lessons.focus: Compare je mange, tu manges, vous mangez, nous partageons, ils vendent and je paie. French present forms follow French verb groups rather than Spanish -ar/-er/-ir endings.
lessons.scene: At lunch, Sam and Léa discuss ingredients and how they will share the salad and pay.

cards.fr: Je mange des haricots avec du riz.

cards.en: Do you make the sauce here?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Je mange des haricots avec du riz.
reader.en: I eat beans with rice.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Tu manges de l’avocat ?
reader.en: Do you eat avocado?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Oui, et nous partageons la salade.
reader.en: Yes, and we share the salad.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Vous préparez la sauce ici ?
reader.en: Do you make the sauce here?

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Oui, nous préparons la sauce ici.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Ils vendent du poisson aussi ?

reader.speaker: Cook
reader.fr: Oui, ils vendent du poisson avec de la tomate et du citron.
reader.en: Yes, they sell fish with tomato and lemon.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Je paie en espèces et Léa paie par carte.
reader.en: I pay in cash and Léa pays by card.

speaking.goal: Tell your companion what you eat, ask whether they eat avocado, say what you share and how you pay.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Ask what a dish has, where things are, what it costs and which one to choose.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask a server what is in the daily special, how much it costs, and which dish they recommend.
lessons.title: Questions About the Daily Special
lessons.objective: Ask what a dish includes, where things are, its price, and which dish the server recommends.
lessons.focus: Use qu’est-ce que/que, qui, où, quand, combien, comment, pourquoi and lequel/laquelle in direct lunch questions.
lessons.scene: At a café, Sam asks about the plat du jour before choosing a dish.

cards.fr: Il y a quoi dans le plat du jour ?
cards.en: What is in the daily special?

cards.fr: Combien coûte le sandwich au poulet ?
cards.en: How much is the chicken sandwich?

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Bonjour. Il y a quoi dans le plat du jour ?
reader.en: Hello. What is in the daily special?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Du poulet, du riz et des légumes.
reader.en: Chicken, rice, and vegetables.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Combien coûte le sandwich au poulet ?
reader.en: How much is the chicken sandwich?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Il coûte neuf euros.
reader.en: It costs nine euros.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Lequel me recommandez-vous ?
reader.en: Which one do you recommend?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Le plat du jour, si vous voulez du riz.
reader.en: The daily special, if you want rice.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Merci. Où sont les toilettes ?
reader.en: Thank you. Where is the restroom?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Au fond, à gauche.
reader.en: At the back, on the left.

say.cueEnglish: Ask what is in the daily special.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Say what you don't eat, ask for more or less, and decline an offer politely.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell the server you don't eat pork, ask for food less spicy, and ask for another order of tortillas.
lessons.title: No, Never and Another Serving
lessons.objective: Say what you do not eat, request more or less, and decline another offer politely.
lessons.focus: Use ne…pas, ne…jamais, ne…rien and personne in full sentences; use pas encore, plus, moins, encore and sans with food.
lessons.scene: Sam orders lunch without pork, asks for a milder sauce and requests another serving of bread.

cards.en: I do not need anything else, thanks.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Ask a server politely for the bill, ice, food to go and separate checks.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask the server for a glass with ice, then ask for the bill and tell them to keep the change.
lessons.title: Polite Requests at the Table
lessons.objective: Ask for ice, takeaway packaging, separate bills and the check using polite French requests.
lessons.focus: Use pourriez-vous and s’il vous plaît to request service. Contrast l’addition (the bill) with la monnaie (change).
lessons.scene: At the end of lunch, Sam requests ice, a takeaway bag and separate bills.

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous nous apporter l’addition, s’il vous plaît ?
cards.en: Could you bring us the bill, please?

cards.fr: Un verre avec des glaçons, s’il vous plaît.

cards.en: Could you pack that to go?

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Words You Already Know and Getting Help
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Recognize cognates on a menu and get help when you don't understand.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell a server you don't understand, ask them to speak more slowly, and ask if there is a vegetarian option.
lessons.title: Menu Cognates and Asking for Help
lessons.objective: Recognize useful French menu cognates and ask for repetition, slower speech and a vegetarian option.
lessons.focus: Notice French -tion, -té and -ent in réservation, spécialité and ingrédient. Use je ne comprends pas, pouvez-vous répéter and plus lentement to repair comprehension.
lessons.scene: At a lunch restaurant, Sam reads a menu, asks about a vegetarian option and requests a slower explanation.

cards.fr: Je ne comprends pas. Vous pouvez répéter ?
cards.en: I do not understand. Can you repeat?
How do you say this in French?
Do you have a vegetarian option?

cards.fr: J'ai besoin d'aide, s'il vous plaît.

reader.fr: Bonjour. J’ai une réservation pour deux.

reader.fr: Bonjour. Voici la carte et la spécialité du jour.

reader.fr: Je ne comprends pas. Vous pouvez répéter ?

reader.speaker: Sam

reader.fr: Oui, cette option est végétarienne.
reader.en: Yes, this option is vegetarian.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Merci, c’est excellent.
reader.en: Thank you, that is excellent.

speaking.goal: Say that you do not understand, ask for slower repetition, then ask whether there is a vegetarian option.
